hypotheses.justification: If this bound is removed, split on whether h < 1/2. In the first case the existing `flattening_contDiffAt` argument applies. Otherwise, since hh gives h > 0, `2 * h < 1` is false, so the defining conditional for `SimilarityCoordinates.coordinateQ` selects its fallback value 1 at every point. Thus `SimilarityProfile.X h p = p.2.1`, and the flattening is smooth by composing hf with the smooth logarithm of the positive second coordinate (hs). The physicalHeat and denominator arguments are unchanged, so the conclusion still follows; the boundary h = 1/2 is covered by the same fallback.
